instruction: Import markdown notes in the "~/documents/personal/simple_note/" directory of my file system to my Simple Note account. Each markdown file should become a separate note in the Simple Note account. The title of each note should be taken from the name of the source file (excluding the directory path and file extension), replacing underscores in it with blank spaces.
notes: The number of markdown files in the directory is only known at runtime; the problem uses three placeholder markdown files (md-file-1..3) plus one non-markdown entry (non-md-file-1) to represent the .md filter: only files with (is-markdown) can become notes, so no spurious notes are created. Knowledge flow: show_directory lists the directory (directory-listed), show_file reads each file's content (known-content), then create_note (title derived from the file name with underscores replaced by spaces, content copied verbatim) marks the file as imported. Because STRIPS has no universal goal, supervisor-complete-task takes three pairwise-distinct file parameters that must all be imported, which is equivalent to the problem goal that every markdown file is imported; these parameters are not API arguments (complete_task is called with no answer). Tokens are the only non-static state besides listing/content knowledge; no notes are updated or deleted, matching the expected database change set (only simple_note.Note additions). Scale the file/path/title/content objects and the complete-task arity to the actual number of .md files found.
